text:
You need a simple, professional website that clearly presents the lawyer’s services and makes it easy for potential clients to get in touch.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I can build a clean, responsive site with straightforward navigation, a polished design, and a contact form that feels reliable and easy to use.

One relevant project I’ve delivered was Charity admin modernisation for Oakfield Charities, where I upgraded a Django 1.11 donor system to Django 4.1 and rebuilt the donation entry screens with HTMX. That work cut donation entry time by 45% while preserving zero data loss across 180k donor records.

If you'd like, I can create a modern site that feels credible, simple, and built for conversion.
